items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: The interviewee, James 'Sugarboy' Crawford, explains that 'Sugar Boy' is his own nickname: 'And he used the nickname that I had since I was a small kid, Sugar Boy.'

ctx.x: When did y'all break up the group?

Well, we didn't really. We had to change the name because of the length of the name. When I got a chance to sign a recording contract, the man didn't want to use the name Shafaka Shaowee on the record. So he just used part of it, Shaowee. And then when I, then it came down and got down to the place where as he only wanted to sign one person to the contract. And since I was the leader of the band, I signed the contract. And he used the nickname that I had since I was a small kid, Sugar Boy. And this is how that…
How did you get the name Sugar Boy?
